decisions.text: The remote will be for TV only (not universal across devices)
We want something that looks good, simple, easy to find (has a locator function), sturdy, and one-handed usable
We want to be modern, fun, different
We want to eliminate unused buttons (only use frequent functions like channel, volume, power)
We want a locator function (e.g., beep to find lost remote)
We decided the remote should probably be one-handed (something we could use with one hand)
Speech recognition is not worth the investment at this point
The ball-shaped remote is probably not a good idea
We will focus on a rounded/one-handed form that fits in the hand (e.g., wrapped around thumb)
We will not do a two-in-one remote (one for zapping + one rounded)
